Beginning on September 17th and continuing until October 3rd, Atlantic Road Construction and Paving on behalf of Halifax Water will complete a culvert replacement near 2884 Lawrencetown Road, Lawrencetown.

The following traffic control will be in place 24/7.
September 17th to September 26th
Local  access only on Lawrencetown Road between the intersection of Mineville Road and Bellefontaine Court.

The following traffic control will be in place Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM only:
September  29th to October 3rd
Stop-and-go traffic on Lawrencetown Road between the intersection of Mineville Road       and Bellefontaine Court.
